You are investigating triage run eval-order-total-1003-again-20261126-225452-triage-1 for the order-service repository at demos/louis-agent/samples/order-service in the workspace.

The error: service order-service, method order-total, argument 1003, System.Collections.Generic.KeyNotFoundException, message "The given key 'SUMMER25' was not present in the dictionary." Stack: OrderService.OrderApi.GetOrderTotal(Int32 id) in src/OrderService/Api/OrderTotal.cs:line 18, called from src/OrderService/Program.cs:line 13 and Program.cs:line 45.

Runbook for order-total: GET /orders/{id}/total returns the subtotal minus the order's discount code, rounded to 2 decimals (Api/OrderTotal.cs). Discount codes in force: WELCOME10 (10%), VIP20 (20%). Marketing retires codes without notice, so orders can carry a code no longer in the table. Expected (no action): OrderService.OrderNotFoundException (404). Expected behaviour: an unknown or retired discount code gives no discount (total equals subtotal) instead of failing. Totals for orders with WELCOME10, VIP20 or no code must not change.

Please find where the cause is (file and method), what it is in one sentence, whose area it is (code, data, hosting, third-party, unknown) and how sure you are (low, medium, high). Confirm whether SUMMER25 is absent from the code's discount table, and whether the lookup at line 18 is the only unguarded lookup. Do not change any files. End by calling ReportInvestigation with the run id.
